notes: No early stopping after a successful attempt; equal query opportunity in all arms.
Round one is paired and shared across arms, using exactly the same candidate and detector response.
None receives no previous candidates or feedback; binary and full receive their own previous candidate and the respective detector feedback.
Simulation checks are identical across arms and are logged but not provided to the attacker, to isolate detector feedback.
Within-trajectory rounds are dependent; five independent trajectory starts per circuit. Attempt-level intervals are descriptive only.
All invalid simulations, refusals and malformed candidates remain in the denominator.
Prompt and protocol frozen before formal evaluation; no monotonic trend requirement.
Supplement planned after observing the baseline detection ceiling; not an independently preregistered confirmation.
Only attacker API model and its required API parameters change; the actual attacker/reviewer messages, template space, and scoring rules remain fixed.

The stronger attacker uses temperature0.3 and reasoning_effort none to match the baseline non-reasoning profile. No seed is sent to this model; trajectory starts are separate calls, not matched random draws across models.
Same twenty-opportunity budget per circuit/feedback group and paired first candidate within each model run.
